title: Touring with Ella Fitzgerald and emphysema
summary: Norman Granz hired him for Ella; the travel nearly killed him, he developed emphysema and quit.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Finally, I stayed here... Then finally Norman Granz called me. And I didn't realize how I was getting. Then I took this job with Ella. I didn't know anything about what her schedule was. I didn't realize how much traveling she did and what it was like. I was with her for two years, and it almost killed me. I wound up with emphysema, and I had to quit. So I went to Los Angeles, and, I was old enough to qualify for unemployment...
Yeah, Social Security. And I started getting that. I just didn't want to play, anyway.
